title: A Provocative AI Jobs Claim, With Little Evidence Yet
dek: A Hacker News submission argues that writing may be the safest job from AI. The available source material offers the headline, but not the evidence needed for workforce planning.
socialCaption: A Hacker News headline says writing may be the safest job from AI. The supplied source offers no evidence behind the claim—making it a useful prompt, not a workforce forecast. Here are the questions leaders should ask before acting.
